# HEM v0.7.4b8 — Complete translation coverage in all 38 languages

- Fills missing translations across native Home Assistant entities, status messages, service descriptions, settings, device options, notifications and the HEM card. Full explanations retain their measurement requirements, timing limits, permissions and safeguards.
- Adds complete localized metric and science help, PID explanations, presence and arrival guidance, door coordination, AQI scale information and equipment help. Activity descriptions remain attached to the reading they concern, with the existing icon colours and information bubbles.
- Fixes regional language selection for Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. A card using a different language from Home Assistant can translate built-in setting and option labels without changing user-defined names or native Select values.
- Restores missing room-name placeholders and synchronizes the master native strings with English. Corrects window-opening and closing notification titles in the supplemental languages.
- Restores all 38 recognizable language names in the announcement language menu. Clarifies target-only control, device on/off and mode control, air extraction, particle filtration and sleep targets without changing their stored options.
- Adds eight missing native form error messages and replaces 37 generic or incomplete validation messages with actionable explanations in every language. Error checks now follow the messages actually emitted by configuration code and preserve temperature gaps, sensor requirements, schedules and numeric limits.
- Fixes ordinary card setting names when the viewer and Home Assistant server use different languages, while preserving user-defined names.
- Replaces generic configuration-help placeholders with the full explanations for all 207 reviewed form descriptions. Restores sensor requirements, provider scales, device permissions, runtime limits and occupancy conditions, and replaces remaining internal setting identifiers with readable labels.
- Updates every translated README with settings levels, optional outdoor AQI and balcony-door inputs. Existing translation-review notices remain accurate and are shown in the page's language.
- Adds strict language coverage, placeholder, runtime and reproducible-build checks to validation. Translations are bundled locally; entity metadata stays bounded, and the generated Python catalog has a size regression guard.

All 38 supported languages are covered by the automated checks. This does not certify a native-speaker editorial review of every translation.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard.
